02Featured case study

Next Play
Operations System

Founder-led growth, needing structure

Next Play was growing from a small founder-led operation. ClickUp was not fully organized, information was spread across different systems, Google Drive needed restructuring, and key processes were not consistently documented. The business needed a clearer operating system.

BEFORE

  • Scattered information
  • Unclear workflows
  • Founder dependency
  • Inconsistent documentation

SYSTEM

  • ClickUp structure
  • Google Drive architecture
  • SOPs
  • Clear ownership
  • Repeatable workflows

AFTER

  • Better visibility
  • Clearer accountability
  • More organized execution
  • Scalable operational foundation
  • Mapped existing operational workflows
  • Identified gaps and bottlenecks
  • Restructured ClickUp
  • Created clearer project and task management
  • Organized Google Drive into a logical company structure
  • Developed SOPs and documentation
  • Clarified ownership
  • Improved visibility across workstreams

03Systems lab · proof of work

What I have actually built.

Real builds, shown at full proportion. Click any screenshot to open it full screen.

GoHighLevel

Coach Onboarding & Offboarding

PurposeTwo structured workflows designed to reduce manual steps and make coach onboarding and offboarding consistent.

Visible in the buildsOnboarding: form trigger, webhook, assignment, internal notification, tag and opportunity update. Offboarding: form trigger, contact lookup with found and not found paths, tag changes, notification and contact removal.

ClickUp

Marketing Agency Planning

Structured project planning, quarterly visibility and organized marketing execution. Key results are grouped by quarter with status and progress, and the marketing plan is grouped by OKR with dates, channels and budget. A dashboard brings revenue remaining, tasks remaining, pipeline tasks by status and weekly priorities into one view.

Make.com

Routing Logic

PurposeA scenario that splits on a condition before adding a row in a spreadsheet.

Visible in the buildA weather module, a router, and a filter checking whether temperature is above 20.
